replicate_statements: The data are presented as mean ± SD. Statistical analysis involved Student's t‐test and one‐way ANOVA followed by post hoc Tukey's HSD (honestly significant difference) test.
outputs.explanation: The quantification graphs report a numeric replicate count ('N=4'), but neither the caption nor the panel states what this N represents (e.g., mice, independent blots, or technical replicates), so the type of replicate is not reported.

The immunoelectron microscopy images are presented as representative findings (multiple fields/panels shown), implying repeated observations, but the caption gives no number of animals, sections, or images examined, nor any description of replicate type.

A single representative Western blot is shown comparing purification methods, but there is no statement of how many times the experiment was repeated or how many animals/samples were used, so replication cannot be assessed.

The proteinase K protection Western blot is shown as a single representative experiment with no indication of the number of independent experiments or samples performed, nor the type of replicate used.
